item.manyl_mod.vow_ring.desc: Gift to a Valkyrie to seal an eternal vow and clear jealousy ♥
gui.manyl_mod.disband_hint: All gear and items return to your inventory
gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift_bar_hint: Hold a flower, gem, gold, or sweet food to give as a gift
gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.perk.none: Perk: invite her to unlock care & protective aura
gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.perk.friend: Perk: heals you when your HP drops below 50%
gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.perk.crush: Perk: Speed + Regen aura & shares snacks
gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.perk.beloved: Perk ♥: Regen/Speed aura + emergency low-HP rescue
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.wild_greetin: Greetings, traveler! I wander these lands seeking a worthy companion. Shall we go together?
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.recruited: I gladly join your side! Together we need fear no darkness.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.need_recruit: Invite me to travel with you first, and my blade will be yours.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.ally: Greetings! Good to see you. Where do we march next?
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.friend: Greetings! Good to see you, my friend!
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.crush: Greetings! Good to see you... How are you feeling today?
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.belove: I am always by your side! My heart is at peace near you ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.jealou: Hmph! Don't look at the others! Finally remembered me?
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.ally.0: My armor is forged from silver and steel, yet true strength comes from the purpose we fight for.
I enjoy traveling with you. You have a kind heart and care deeply for your companions.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.crush.0: You know, I catch myself looking for you even when everything around us is calm and quiet.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.beloved: While I am near, no shadow will touch you. Stay safe, my love ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.compliment.e: Haha, oh stop it! Thank you!
Hehe... That makes me so happy!
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.compliment.c: Hehe... Hearing that from you makes me so happy ♥
Haha, thank you! Your kind words warm my heart ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.compliment.b: Haha, thank you! With you I feel like I could soar above the clouds ♥
Hehe... That makes me so happy! I love you ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift_hint: Hold a flower, diamond, amethyst, emerald, gold, or tasty food and press Give Gift.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.flower: What a wonderful gift! Thank you, I will keep it close to my heart ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.vow_rin: Is this the Vow Ring?.. I accept your vow with all my heart — only you live in my soul now, with no jealousy ever again ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.diamond: What a wonderful gift! This diamond is priceless — I will keep it close to my heart ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.gem: What a wonderful gift! Thank you, it shines like your eyes ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.gold: What a wonderful gift! Thank you for the fine gold and care!
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.sweet: Mmm, so delicious! Thank you for the treat and your care ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.food: Mmm, so delicious! Thank you for the treat and your care!
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.confess_too_: Sigh... Let us grow just a little closer first...
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.confess_alre: I am always by your side! My heart is already yours ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.confess_succ: I waited so long for these words! My heart and my blade are yours forever ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.mode_stay: Alright, I will wait for you right here.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.mode_follow: Greetings! I am right behind you again!
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_rescue: §d[Valkyrie]§r "Hold on! I've got you!" §c(Emergency care shield ♥)
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_care_heal: §d[Valkyrie]§r "I'm always by your side! Patched you up ♥"
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_share_food: §d[Valkyrie]§r "Here, have a bite to keep your strength up ♥"
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_jealous_warn: §6[Valkyrie is jealous]§r "Hmph! Don't look at the others!"
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_jealous_slap: §c[Valkyrie is jealous]§r "Hmph! Don't look at the others!" §7(-1♥, jealousy 75%)
msg.manyl_mod.vow_ring_accepted: §d[Valkyrie]§r "I accept the Vow Ring! My heart is forever yours ♥" §a(Jealousy cleared)
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_campfire_event: §d[Valkyrie by the fire]§r "How peaceful it is to sit with you by a warm fire under the stars ♥"
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_flower_event: §d[Valkyrie]§r "I found this flower along the road and thought of you ♥"
